title: Adia Med of Winter Park LLC Autism Spectrum Disorder Stem Cell vs. Placebo Research Study
official: Adia Med of Winter Park LLC Autism Spectrum Disorder Research Study
summary: This randomized, placebo-controlled study evaluates the safety and preliminary efficacy of AdiaVita (umbilical cord blood-derived stem cell and exosome product) compared with saline placebo in children aged 3-12 years with autism spectrum disorder (ASD). Approximately 100 participants will be enrolled at two sites and randomly assigned 1:1 to receive three monthly intravenous infusions of either AdiaVita or saline placebo. The primary outcome is the change in parent-reported Autism Treatment Evaluation Checklist (ATEC) total score from baseline to Month 3. After the Month 3 assessment, eligible participants who received placebo may cross over to receive AdiaVita. All participants are followed through Month 12 for safety and additional outcome assessments. AdiaVita is not FDA-approved for the treatment of ASD.

interventions.name: Umbilical Cord Blood-Derived Stem Cells and Exosomes

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 3-12 years
* Confirmed ASD diagnosis (DSM-5 criteria, supported by ADOS-2)
* Parent/guardian willingness to consider experimental treatments and comply with study requirements
* Ability to obtain required bloodwork
* Ability to attend all scheduled visits

Exclusion Criteria:

* Severe allergies to study products
* Significant uncontrolled medical conditions, including:
* Uncontrolled seizure disorder (seizure medication changed within the past 3 months)
* Known heart disease or unexplained fainting, unless cleared by the child's cardiologist
* Known bleeding or clotting disorder
* Screening lab values outside the acceptable ranges (see Laboratory Screening)
* Immunocompromised
* Malignancy history
* Unstable medication regimen or inconsistent medication adherence (e.g., frequent medication changes or missed doses) within 30 days prior to Baseline, at Investigator discretion
* Pregnancy or breastfeeding (if applicable)
* Participation in another interventional trial within 30 days
* Have received stem cell therapy prior to the study
* Have received exosome therapy prior to the study
